name: Ouija Boards
overview: Scripture clearly condemns any involvement with familiar spirits, wizards, and divination, warning believers to avoid these practices to prevent defilement and separation from God's people. Leviticus emphasizes the seriousness of seeking such occult influences, even prescribing death for those who engage in them, while Deuteronomy commands believers to detest and abhor these abominations. Jesus further cautions His followers to be vigilant against deception, underscoring the spiritual danger inherent in occult practices like using Ouija boards.
